Smart Study Planner

Add your study plan, and LearnBridge will remind you at the time you choose.

Your reminders are created only from the plans you save. Choose your subject, study day, start time, and how early you want to be reminded. You can remove a plan whenever you want.

Choose a date to see its day, month, and year in both calendars.

Reminders are based only on your saved study plans. Keep LearnBridge open for browser reminders; reminders while the browser is fully closed require a native Android app or a server-backed push notification setup.

About LearnBridge

Learn Today. Build Tomorrow.

Our mission

LearnBridge helps students, especially those who find it hard to get quality study materials, prepare for the Ethiopian university entrance examination. We provide lesson notes, practice quizzes and a study planner that work on a phone.

What you can do here

Study lessons by subject, practise with quizzes and mock examinations, track your progress, and plan your study week.

Founder

LearnBridge was started by Mahlet Hagos, a student from Ethiopia who believes technology and education can open opportunities for every learner.

Feedback and problems

Tell us about a problem, a wrong answer, a missing topic, or any idea to make LearnBridge better.

Version

LearnBridge web app, 2026.

Resources

Helpful ways to use LearnBridge well.

Start with a lesson

Read the notes for one topic, then test yourself with a short quiz on the same subject.

Practise with quizzes

Choose a subject and a number of questions. Use the "After each question" setting to see the reason behind every answer, shown with a green tick for the correct answer and a red cross for wrong choices.

Plan your week

Set aside a fixed time each day for one subject. Short, regular study works better than long sessions before the exam.

Check your progress

Your completed topics and milestones appear on the Progress page. Review the topics you find hardest.

Study tips
  • Read each question carefully and look for key words such as "not", "except" and "most".
  • Review every wrong answer and write down the rule you missed.
  • Take a timed mock examination once a week to build speed.
  • Check your work in Mathematics and Physics step by step.
